horoscope: There is some caution or introspection early today, dear Aries. Saturn is currently transiting your sign, and as it faces off with the Sun, it might bring worries or frustrations to your attention to handle. Fear of not getting what you want shouldn’t stop you from even trying, and right now, you may be refusing to play the game so you won’t have to face the possibility of losing. Keep in mind that the limitations you encounter now can set you on a new path that better aligns with your values or benefits you more. Aim to be as patient as you can, both with others and with yourself if things are not going the way you expected. You may get the sense that you’re dealing with everything on your own, and if so, consider possible ways to change the situation. Later today, the Moon moves into your creativity sector, and you naturally release tensions through creative, entertaining activities.

With today's Sun-Saturn opposition, dear Taurus, it’s a time to see the reality of a situation, which can lead to the need to make adjustments. There may be tough questions, a reality check, or perhaps some criticism or a delay to deal with, particularly if something was overlooked, neglected, or avoided in the past. You’re motivated to work and take care of business, but you may need to address an emotional matter or an obligation to help someone, delaying things a little. If others aren’t appreciating your efforts, you may need a reminder of what you’re doing it all for, or the need for arriving at an improved work-life balance can become very apparent. Consider that pacing yourself can only be for your benefit! Aim to honor and refine routines or draw more explicit boundaries that separate work and rest to your advantage. Later today, the Moon heads into your solar house of family and home life, encouraging you to find some sustenance through connecting with what's most familiar. Spirits run high for home-related activities, or you may want to resolve a personal problem.

With the Sun's opposition to Saturn today, dear Gemini, a reality check may be in order. While discouraging, it can motivate you to firm up your plans and address important details you’ve overlooked. Ultimately, this works in your favor! Whether you’re feeling a little left out or are in the uncomfortable position of having to discipline or limit someone, you are growing and maturing in the process. It can be empowering to know where you stand, as plans made are sturdier and ultimately more realizable as a result. Limitations you deal with now can open you up to freedoms later. Later today, you enter a more curious lunar period, and it becomes time for branching out and entertaining new possibilities. You might discover a new thing to like about a project or learning endeavor.

The Moon in your sign magnifies your emotions, dear Cancer, but the Moon moves into your solar second house later today, and your emotional requirements don’t appear as urgent. With the Sun opposite Saturn today, a new, more realistic look at your work-home balance is necessary. There can be quite a pull to follow the rules and achieve your goals and ambitions, but you also crave family and home time. If others don’t seem especially sympathetic to your cause, then you’ll be in the position to rely on yourself, which is likely to work out just fine in the end! Remind yourself that you gain strength as you humble yourself to certain realities. As well, this condition is temporary. Taking a second look at personal plans can be useful now. Understanding and compassion are in strong force later today.

The Sun forms its yearly opposition to Saturn today, dear Leo, pointing to a roadblock or reality check. This year, it spreads across your communication and transit sectors. If you’ve let something go or neglected a responsibility or errand, it can now come back to your attention, perhaps with some minor consequences attached. This may also be a time to recognize the limits of time or energy for a project you began about half a year ago. Take this opportunity to make more mature and informed decisions. While criticism may enter the picture, learning from it is possible. Aim to downsize or pare down rather than take on more. With the Moon’s move into later today, emotions are running very close to the surface. Your ability to let go and move on is a good way to take a load off your mind.

The Sun opposes Saturn today, dear Virgo, and you may need to face a financial or relationship reality before moving forward. Someone may be disapproving or less than sympathetic, or drawing boundaries can become necessary. Fortunately, delays occurring now may very well lead to better conditions later, so be willing to muster up patience. Managing problems could prompt you to take better care of your resources. Adjustments you make now may send you in a new direction that better serves you in the long term. It’s a good time to review how you’re managing your resources and talents. Later today, the Moon moves into your privacy sector, encouraging you to take things easy and keep a low profile just for now.

The Sun in your sign opposes Saturn today, dear Libra, and you may need to face up to reality, a restriction, or a responsibility. A relationship challenge could emerge or reach a head, and you may not have others’ full cooperation, but you have the tools to sort things out even without a definite answer. Keep in mind that while critics can be annoying, they may have something to show us. This can be a time to shore things up or take steps to feel less vulnerable if you’ve been overlooking or neglecting a matter. If circumstances or a particular person seem to be slowing you down today, consider stepping back and making corrections. Later today, energies shift, and you can feel far more positive. You might enjoy a refreshing new idea or topic that opens up an interesting line of thought.

A Sun-Saturn opposition occurs today, and this year, it occurs along the work-rest axis of your solar chart, dear Scorpio. This influence can remind you of responsibilities you may have avoided or neglected, or alert you to work that needs edits or adjustments. Obligations you’ve forgotten about or avoided may need your attention now, perhaps with some consequences if you’ve let something slide. The Sun in your privacy sector has been encouraging your need for relaxation, and Saturn serves as a long-term reminder of the tasks that need handling most! This transit is about a better balance inside and out, and you owe it to yourself to go there. As the day advances, it's easier than usual to have a positive frame of mind. You might appreciate things you may have overlooked before, or you see the growth opportunities in your experiences more than usual.

The current Sun transit invites your social side to come out to play, dear Sagittarius, and can point you toward new and exciting projects or other happiness goals. However, Saturn’s influence presents some possible restrictions, and it opposes the Sun today. There can be frustrations, delays, or possibly disapproval in a relationship or with a creative pursuit, or there can be some concerns or anxieties keeping you from thoroughly enjoying yourself just for the time being. This transit reminds you of your responsibilities, and while it can feel limiting, you may very well benefit from slowing down and adjusting some of your plans before going forward. Consider what’s best for you long term. It’s a yearly transit that encourages you to realign, tidy up your life or a project, take care of unfinished business, and adjust expectations. As the day advances, you gain a spirit of hopefulness. The Moon moves into your solar ninth house, inspiring your enthusiasm for a plan, topic, or idea.

With today's Sun-Saturn opposition, dear Capricorn, this yearly transit can serve as a reminder to correct some errors or redirect you if you’ve steered off course. This may be most prominent in your work-home balance. Household or family responsibilities, restructuring, or some personal reservations and fears of exposure or risk can interrupt you now, but efforts to make corrections can be highly beneficial. This is a time for examining whether or not you’ve been practical, or where you may have been self-limiting. You may very well find that you’ve wasted too much energy dreading something that ended up much easier than you’d imagined. With the Moon’s move into your solar eighth house later today, you seek a real connection with someone or a project. You gravitate to captivating, all-consuming activities. You could be itching to make things happen with finances or intimacy.

Today's Sun-Saturn opposition reminds you of your responsibilities, paperwork, errands, or studies that need your attention, dear Aquarius. Regarding a particular project, you may need to go back to the drawing board. Refinements and edits can be necessary now. Worries, fears of expansion, and insecurities might also limit your experiences if you end up indecisive. There could be disapproval or criticism that temporarily puts a damper on things, but it might ultimately motivate you to tighten up your work or brush up on your skills. If there’s no lesson in it, do your best to discard negativity. Find ways to put habits that are holding you back from growing, learning, and experiencing life behind you. The Moon moves into your partnership sector later today, bringing you into a more sociable mood or one in which you’d prefer to share your ideas or activities with someone.

Today's Sun-Saturn opposition may bring a particular responsibility to your attention or an obstacle to overcome, dear Pisces. Blockages related to money or business, and perhaps a stronger need for security and safety, can temporarily disrupt the equilibrium or your enjoyment of a relationship. There may be a disappointment or limitation encountered, or if you’ve let something go or procrastinated on a matter, this can be a time to face it. Fear of loss can be at the root of either possessiveness or emotional distancing in a relationship. As the day advances, transits are strong for resolving a conflict or solving a problem, especially related to sharing, working, and health. The Moon moves into your work and health sector, and focusing on daily routines or details can be comforting.
